answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The voyage is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the onyx. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nadir of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
